heroTitle: Cinematic video for weddings, brands, and the stories in between.
heroSub: Colton Fleming Productions — wedding films, brand advertisements, and corporate interviews, delivered with a cinematic touch. Based in California & Florida.

reviews.name: Dominic
reviews.quote: Colton was great to work with, easy to communicate with, and definitely knowledgeable in all things filmmaking! Eager to possibly work with him again in the future. Highly recommend his video work to anyone in need.

reviews.name: Jonathan Osorio
reviews.quote: We enjoyed what Colton Fleming Productions did for our photography and film — the results were nothing short of amazing. Their attention to detail and storytelling ability truly set them apart.

reviews.name: Garces Bros Studio
reviews.quote: Colton is a solid creative to have on set! He brings a great attitude, is professional, respectful, and always ready to help. He knows his way around the camera.
